findings_from_approved_rules.identity_depends_on_xlsx_checksums: EVE-RUNTIME-CATID-R1 composes catalog_version_id from a canonical manifest including exact SHA-256 of Runtime XLSX and Madre XLSX. Changing authoritative workbook content changes the checksum and therefore the identity.
findings_from_approved_rules.active_full_must_remain_immutable_as_ide: The active FULL identity string is bound to the checksummed sources that produced it. Approved new mapping content that alters those sources cannot be silently written into the same identity.
findings_from_approved_rules.activation_pattern_observed: Phase-2 / 043 activation pattern: load new catalog version as draft → QA → activate; previous active may be superseded; historical identities preserved.
findings_from_approved_rules.sempersist_forbids_invented_aliases: SEMPERSIST-R1 forbids alias/fuzzy creation; new executable mappings require explicit approved rector content, not runtime invention.

dictamen.note: No new version label (e.g. v1.1.2) is assigned here. Identity must be recomputed per EVE-RUNTIME-CATID-R1 after approved source content exists.
